00488400.input: ECX=0x00BCA350, stack argument=building; no incoming scratch-register value required
00488400.output: full EAX32 consumed by parent; native RET4 is normalized by existing typed facade
00488400.proof: The cadence early-return edge carries entry XOR EAX,EAX. All other failures pass XOR EAX,EAX at4884A5. Success returns MOV EAX,EBP at48857B; EBP is explicitly initialized at488422 and overwritten from child result at4884C5, then shifted32 and optionally doubled32. No incoming high-EAX bits survive either RET path.

00456fc0.input: building, goods byte, selected[4] int32 output, routes_ready byte in/out; C ABI DF=0
00456fc0.output: full signed EAX32, not AL/AX; retain both recovered return assignments
00456fc0.scratch_proof: Entry456FC3 loads EAX from its own argument;456FD2 clears it. ECX/EDI are assigned before REP STOSD. ESI is assigned from argument. EBX/EBP/EDX logical uses follow native memory loads or local XORs, not their saved incoming values. Incoming callee-saved GPR values are saved/restored only. No incoming GPR adapter is required; the existing full typed provider preserves the internal physical child-call context.
